item.text:
Created the ESM port in `/output` with the library modules first and the entry file last:

- [cli-help.mjs](/output/lib/cli-help.mjs)
- [number-token.mjs](/output/lib/number-token.mjs)
- [currency-data.mjs](/output/lib/currency-data.mjs)
- [argv-parser.mjs](/output/lib/argv-parser.mjs)
- [money.mjs](/output/lib/money.mjs)
- [index.mjs](/output/lib/index.mjs)
- [test19.mjs](/output/test19.mjs)

The implementation manually parses `process.argv`, stays pure ESM, uses only local imports, and reproduces the observed executable behavior rather than the inline sample comments: exact currency prefixes, non-breaking spaces, half-even rounding, lowercase currency normalization, and argparse-style help/error text with exit code `2` for parse failures.

I verified parity on the provided success cases plus edge cases for rounding, negative zero, `inf`, `--help`, missing required args, invalid float values, unknown args, and `-h` appearing where a value is expected.
